title: CommitmentExtractorOutput
description: Structured commitment extraction output: summary, individual commitments with owners and evidence, unassigned actions, missing-field diagnostics, owner rollup, and metadata — all grounded in transcript evidence.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence overview of extracted commitments: total count, key owners, critical items, and any notable gaps or risks.

commitments.description: Extracted commitments from the transcript, each with owner attribution, evidence, and classification.

unassigned_actions.description: Action items mentioned in the transcript that could not be attributed to a specific owner.

missing_fields.description: Diagnostics for commitments that are missing key fields (owner, due date, artifact, scope clarity). Each entry suggests a follow-up question.

owner_rollup.description: Aggregated commitment counts per owner, including critical-priority count.

metadata.description: Extraction metadata: which input mode was used and when the output was generated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this commitment. Format: CMT-001, CMT-002, etc.

commitment_text.description: Concise, normalized description of the commitment in action-oriented language.

commitment_type.description: Classification of the commitment. 'deliverable' = a tangible output. 'decision' = a choice that was made. 'follow_up' = an action to take after the meeting. 'coordination' = alignment or handoff between people/teams. 'investigation' = research or information gathering.

owner.description: Person responsible for this commitment. Set to 'UNKNOWN' when extraction_mode=inclusive and owner cannot be determined.

owner_confidence.description: Confidence in owner attribution. 'high' = explicitly stated. 'medium' = strongly implied. 'low' = inferred or ambiguous.

due_date_raw.description: Due date as stated in the transcript. Verbatim or near-verbatim. Example: 'next Friday', 'by end of next week', 'in two weeks'.

due_date_normalized.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime if determinable from context, otherwise empty string. Requires meeting_datetime in input for relative date resolution.

status.description: 'new' = first mentioned in this meeting. 'carried' = follow-up from a previous discussion. 'unclear' = cannot determine if new or carried.

priority.description: Assessed priority based on urgency language, speaker authority, and dependency impact.

proof_artifact_expected.description: Tangible output that proves this commitment was fulfilled. Example: 'Revised plan document shared in Slack', 'Email with infra estimates'.

dependencies.description: Other commitments or external factors this commitment depends on. Reference by commitment ID or free-text description.

blockers.description: Known blockers that could prevent completion. Empty array if none identified.

source_evidence.description: Verbatim transcript evidence supporting this commitment. At least one entry required.

confidence_score.description: Overall confidence in this commitment extraction. 0.0 = highly uncertain. 1.0 = explicitly stated with clear owner, due date, and scope.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this appears. Examples: 'opening remarks', 'during infrastructure discussion', 'closing action items'.

commitment_id.description: ID of the commitment with missing fields. Must reference a valid commitment ID.

missing.description: List of missing or underspecified fields on this commitment.

suggested_followup_question.description: A concrete question to ask in order to fill the missing field(s).

owner.description: Owner name matching commitment owner fields.

count.description: Total number of commitments assigned to this owner.

critical_count.description: Number of critical-priority commitments assigned to this owner.

mode_used.description: Which input mode was detected. 'transcript_only' if no optional context fields were provided; 'transcript_plus_context' otherwise.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this extraction was generated.
